verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents a user-configured background automation in Dunning. It sends email reminders and schedules payment retries at intervals, and Smart retry adjusts those intervals automatically by decline type. That is genuine autonomous, recurring background behaviour, but it is limited to payment recovery. Missing for 10: a general-purpose automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers and actions beyond dunning, scheduling of arbitrary tasks, AI-agent-driven autonomous background runs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: With Chargebee's Dunning feature, you can send email reminders to your customers asking them to update payment details and schedule payment retries at intervals to ensure revenue can be recovered.
Chargebee's Smart retry logic retries payments at dynamic intervals based on the type of gateway transaction errors, and it acts on the hard or soft declines accordingly.
